scenes.voice: Agar tum bhi BLS Polymers IPO mein apne 15 hazar lagane ki soch rahe ho, toh pehle in numbers ki asliyat sun lo.
scenes.headline: THE DARK SIDE OF BLS IPO

scenes.voice: Sab bol rahe hain profit 27 crore ho gaya, par sach ye hai ki inki revenue growth gir kar sirf 6 percent reh gayi hai. Ye thoda ajeeb nahi lagta?
scenes.headline: REVENUE SLOWDOWN
scenes.label: Growth Drop

scenes.voice: Valuation dekhein toh 34 ke P/E ratio par ye apne competitors se kaafi mehanga IPO de rahe hain. Aur crude oil ka risk alag se hai.
scenes.headline: EXPENSIVE VALUATION

scenes.voice: Sabse bada risk batau? Inka 66 percent dhanda sirf top 10 clients se aata hai, aur poori manufacturing sirf ek Goa ki factory par dependent hai.
scenes.headline: SINGLE POINT OF FAILURE
scenes.body: Over-dependent on Top 10 clients and a single Goa manufacturing plant.
scenes.cardText: Over-dependent on Top 10 clients and a single Goa manufacturing plant.

scenes.voice: Brokerages naye expansion ke dum par isko long-term hold bata rahi hain. Tumhara kya plan hai? Asli market reality ke liye techwith.GenZ ko follow karo.
scenes.headline: WHAT'S YOUR PLAN?
